title: Grand Canyon West VIP
name: Grand Canyon West
p1: Three days and two nights at Grand Canyon West with VIP all-access. See the canyon from a helicopter, on horseback, by ATV, from the Skywalk and on a canopy zipline, then end the day under the stars.
p2: Two nights in a luxury Stargazer Dome, gourmet meals, snacks and unlimited beverages are included. Drive or fly in, and the rest is arranged.
presImg: Golden light on the canyon rim
presText: Day two is the full experience: helicopter, horseback, ATV, the Skywalk and the canopy zipline, plus a Hualapai Indigenous performance. Evenings close with stargazing and a campfire.
wideImg: Deep canyon layers in late light
highlights: Grand Canyon West All-Access Pass and the Skywalk
